Very disappointed with my first experience bringing my cat here for grooming. I brought him in to have his hair trimmed and, most importantly, to have some knots removed. I understand that it was his first time being groomed and that cats can sometimes be difficult to work with, but in the end they only shaved his belly that’s fine, because he had a lot of knots, but not even trimmed his hair and I was charged $63.

For that price, I expected more of the service I originally brought him in for. . I left feeling like I paid $63 for only a small part of the grooming I requested.

Unfortunately, based on this first experience, I’m disappointed with the service and the value for the price.

This rating is ONLY for the GROOMING service.  I went to Peluche on Williams  in Montreal to get my dog groomed back about 5 months ago.  The grooming was ok but nothing great.  The groomer didn’t cut my dog’s nail because she told me his nails were too short and didn’t need cutting.  I thought that was strange but ok.

I booked a grooming 3 to 4 months later only for the appointment to be cancelled the day before the appointment.  I rebooked.  I dropped my dog there after explaining what I was looking for and also explained that my dog could be difficult with his nails getting cut.

I received a call about 30 min after I dropped off my dog.  The groomer told me he couldn’t continue because my dog was too difficult.  I asked what can be done but the groomer had no options to offer.  I was worried about the dewclaws as they were very long.  I suggested he cut them while I held my dog and gave him treats. That worked well.

Having ONLY bathed my dog, the groomer charged me $75 .  Ridiculous.

I went to another much more experienced groomer after my dreadful experience with the groomer at Peluche, who cut my dog’s nails in about 10 to 12 minutes.  She charged me $12 for the nail cutting.

I will NEVER get my dog groomed at Peluche again.  Their groomers are very inexperienced and charge much too much for a simple wash.  This is a scam.

And I did have groomed my cat once here, when I was back at home, I found something I expected to be done but not, and still costs me 90. And you need to wait about half a month to get an appointment for grooming. It might be a good place for dog tbh but not for cat. Hope this is useful to everyone.
